title: The most engaging coding teaching program out there!
text:
First - yes, it feels little pricey when you get it, but that's mostly because you receive written material and don't realize instinctively that you are also paying for the use of the platform (they do have a PDF download that's a lot cheaper, but I found that my kids really liked the tangible instructions).
I have a 7 & 9 year olds and we've tried coding classes, online coding classes, other platforms, coding robots etc. There has been nothing that excited them as much as coding their own games from scratch.
label: positive
